title: Beyond My Touch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At the funeral of his classmate Mamoru Takayama, Mizuno meets Takayama's ghost, who cannot rest because of unfinished business: he wants to kiss Mizuno (AniList, MU). The volume adds an epilogue and the short stories "Gift", "Cool Lips" and "Recipe" (MU).
life_message: Unspoken feelings matter enough to hold a soul back, so say them while you can.

content.note: A ghost at his own funeral, played for comedy (AniList, MU Comedy, Ghost/s).
A stolen kiss is the ghost's goal; MU Shounen Ai (no sex categories).
Death of a classmate and lingering attachment (AniList, MU Dead Protagonist).
Stealing a kiss framed as comedy.

folkways.japan: The premise draws on Japanese folk belief that a spirit with strong lingering attachment (miren) cannot pass on after the funeral.
